prerequisite_evaluations.prerequisite: Wind Speed -> Wind Power Generation Mapping
prerequisite_evaluations.why_required: ForecastBundle v1.0 and EMS optimizer require wind power in Watts (W), whereas A2 produces wind speed in m/s.
prerequisite_evaluations.evidence_established: A2 Ridge AR-X verified for 10m wind speed (2.0364 m/s test MAE).
prerequisite_evaluations.evidence_missing: Turbine power curve, hub height, rotor area, and efficiency loss formulations.

prerequisite_evaluations.evidence_established: Abisko Aut (392m) established as conditional regional proxy for Nuolja (702m).
prerequisite_evaluations.why_required: Vertical elevation delta (310m) introduces boundary layer velocity shear.
prerequisite_evaluations.evidence_missing: Boundary layer log-law or power-law wind shear scaling parameters.

prerequisite_evaluations.why_required: ForecastBundle v1.0 schema enforces wind_generation field in Watts with point, lower, upper arrays.
prerequisite_evaluations.evidence_established: Schema v1.0 strictly inspected and frozen.
prerequisite_evaluations.evidence_missing: Governance decision on whether to add wind_speed (m/s) field or require generation (W).

prerequisite_evaluations.why_required: Engine interface expects predict(station_state, context) -> ForecastBundle.
EMS microgrid optimizer consumes ForecastBundle for closed-loop control.
prerequisite_evaluations.evidence_missing: End-to-end integration tests with wind inputs.

A.description: Formulate scientific transformation mapping 10m wind speed (m/s) to electrical power (W).
A.justification: Primary physical dependency link; must be resolved before ForecastBundle representation can be finalized.

B.description: Formulate altitude lapse rate and wind shear scaling from Abisko (392m) to Nuolja (702m).
B.justification: Important for site accuracy, but speed-to-power mapping is necessary regardless of proxy site elevation.

C.description: Resolve ForecastBundle schema representation for wind speed vs wind generation.
C.justification: Cannot resolve schema contract until physical target quantity (power vs speed) is defined.

D.description: Implement wrapper adapter class for ForecastEngine interface.
D.justification: Cannot build software adapter before schema contract is resolved.

E.description: Validate wind forecast consumption in EMS optimizer.
E.justification: Final step in integration chain; requires operational ForecastEngine adapter.

F.description: Indicates ambiguity or missing evidence preventing candidate identification.
F.justification: Evidence is clear and dependency chain is fully established.
